ج/ر/ي   j–r–y to run, to flow, to stream, to sail
; stream, channel, the way of things; vessel, boat; to continue, to be constant; young female, overseer.

Of this root, 5 forms occur 64 times in the Qur’an:
جَرَى jarā 57 times; جَارِيَةٌ jāriyatun 2 times; جَارِيَاتٌ jāriyāt 1 time; جَوَارِي jawārı 3 times and مَجْرِي majrı 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
جَرَى jarā i [v. intrans.]

1 to run

(31:29) وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى He has subjected the sun and the moon, each to run [its course] for a stated term

2 to flow

(5:119) لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ for them are gardens through which streams flow

3 to sail

(22:65) وَالْفُلْكَ تَجْرِي فِى الْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِ and the ships sail the sea by His command

4 to blow

(21:81) وَلِسُلَيْمَانَ الرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ and for Solomon [We subjected] the wind, stormy, blowing by His (or, Solomon’s) command.

entries.label: جَارِيَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
جَارِيَةٌ jāriyatun [n./act. part. fem., pl. جَارِيَاتٌ jāriyāt and جَوَارِي jawārı]

1 that which sails, water vessel, boat

(69:11) إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَى الْمَاءُ حَمَلْنَاكُمْ فِى الْجَارِيَةِ when the water flooded, it was We who carried you in the sailing vessel

2 that which flows, flowing, (of water) running

(88:12) فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ in it there is a flowing spring

3 stars and planets

(81:16) الْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ the [stars and planets] that run and sink [out of sight].

entries.label: مَجْرِي
entries.definitionHtml:
مَجْرِي majrı [v. n. (also read as مُجْرِى mujrı act. part.)] sailing

(11:41) وَقَالَ ارْكَبُوا فِيهَا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا and He said, ‘Board it [the ark]; in the name of God is its sailing and its anchoring.’
